page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear performance tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded workloads. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Single-threaded gzip and bzip3 compression speeds are also poor. However, the instance demonstrates average multi-core and memory bandwidth performance, achieving middle-tier results in multi-threaded Geekbench, Passmark CPU, and bzip3 decompression tests.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers dedicated resource allocation on an older Intel Xeon architecture. This makes it a viable option for workloads that benefit from consistent, non-burstable CPU allocation without requiring the high clock speeds or advanced instruction sets of newer processor generations.

This instance is suitable for multi-threaded general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate software compilation tasks. It can also handle light LLM inference for small models, though performance drops significantly on medium-sized models.
